entries.zh: 放声大哭；哭到涕泪俱尽、声音哽咽。
entries.en: to weep aloud; to sob until tears and voice are spent.
entries.notes: H 末字「嚕」与 M lǔy（淚）不合，M 实与「涕盡咽淚」相应；H 第三字〔咽/咱〕未定。

entries.en: to wail; to cry out loudly in grief.
entries.notes: H 第三字作「口」与 M「áy áy」不合，疑为「哀」之残；M 并列两读（caû áy áy / cús áy áy）。

entries.en: to wail and sob.
to wail again and again; to cry out repeatedly.
entries.notes: 「〻」为重文号，H 即「號號哭」，与 M hǒ̃ hǒ̃ caù 相合。

entries.zh: 哭出声来；有声有泪地哭。
entries.en: to weep aloud with tears; to cry audibly.
entries.notes: H「聲涕」非习见词，M siâ-tī 于「聲啼／聲涕」皆可通，依 L「a voces」取出声而哭。

entries.en: to weep tears of grief; to shed sorrowful tears.
entries.notes: L「cuxiendo」疑为「corriendo」（泪流而下），H 哀淚与 M ay-lǔy 互合。

entries.en: to weep with tears streaming; tears running from the eyes.
entries.notes: H 第三字〔睭/屎〕未定，两读均指流泪，与 L「corriendo las lágrimas」相合。

entries.en: to shed tears.
entries.notes: H 首字〔下/卜〕未定，M hě 与「下」合（下淚＝落泪）。

entries.en: to weep over great hardships; tears of misery.
to cry bitterly in great hardship.

entries.zh: 极可悲、令人不禁落泪（字面「十目好啼」）。
entries.en: deeply lamentable; a sight that would make many eyes weep.
entries.notes: H「十目好啼」字面难解，M chap-bac-hò-tī 与之相合；暂依 L「cosa digna de ser llorada」定意，存疑。

entries.en: to rain; rain.
entries.notes: M 栏 hōi-lǒ-hǒu 三音节与单字「雨」不合，疑连读「雨／落雨」。

entries.en: to rain without ceasing; to pour steadily.
entries.notes: L 栏「Llorar」按「Llover」读（H 淋、M līm 合），「sin escampar」谓雨不止。

entries.en: to drip (of rain); to fall drop by drop.
entries.notes: L 栏「Llorar」按「Llover」读，H 滴＝M tī 相合。

entries.en: to drip steadily; soaking, dripping rain.
entries.notes: L 栏「Llorar」按「Llover」读；H「淋滴」即「淋漓」，M līm-tī 相合。

entries.en: to rain.

entries.zh: 愈哭愈甚；泪（雨）接连不断地落。
entries.en: to weep more and more; to fall in an unbroken stream.
entries.notes: H「連〻落」谓接连落下，与 L「más y más」相合；L 栏动词按「Llover」读。

entries.en: to rain after a long drought; to be drenched by rain.
entries.notes: L 栏按「Llover」读（H 淋雨），「mucha seca」谓久旱；M 栏多一音节 ō。

entries.en: to rain in darkness; dark, overcast rain.
entries.notes: H 暗雨＝M âm-hǒu 相合；M 栏第二写法残缺，L 栏动词按「Llover」读。

entries.en: to rain with a storm and hail; a storm disaster.
entries.notes: L 末「gre drisco」残讹，疑为「gran pedrisco」（大冰雹）；H 災害＝M chāy-hay 相合。
